name: Instance Color Rules
description: Opens a movable window, live-updating as the model changes, that colors the active model by rules you define against any built-in property or Advanced Attribute (e.g. Status equals 'Installed' → Blue, else Gray), beside the modeling view, without touching materials or styles.
creator: Trimble Engineering

open-tag-color-viewer.title: Instance Color Rules
open-tag-color-viewer.description: Open a live-updating window that colors the model by rules you define.
